definitions.explanation: Widely known by many people. Can describe people, places, or things.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{歌手|かしゅ}です。
この{料理|りょうり}は{有名|ゆうめい}ですね。
examples.english: This dish is famous, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}で{一番|いちばん}{有名|ゆうめい}な{山|やま}は{富士山|ふじさん}です。
examples.english: The most famous mountain in Japan is Mt. Fuji.

notes: 有名 is a na-adjective: 有名な (before nouns), 有名だ/です (predicate), 有名じゃない (negative), 有名だった (past). The kanji literally mean 'have name' - something so notable it has a name. Antonym: 無名 (むめい - unknown, obscure).
